one_line: Live end-to-end proof that a truly-dispatched leg's REAL transcript settles integer tokens into the rails ledger at its done transition, and a tiny tokens ceiling crossed at settle halts the NEXT dispatch - run against a throwaway scratch repo, never the live repo.
scratch_isolation: fresh git repo, NO origin remote (Backup-Branches pushes nowhere); orchestrate.ps1 is a COPY so $PSScriptRoot lock/log dirs are isolated from the live orchestrator (pid 45412) coordinating this wave; ledgers under the scratch harness/battleplan/runs.
product_code_touched: none - orchestrate.ps1 + rails.py are COPIED verbatim from the live repo (sha-identical source) and driven read-only; only scratch + artifact files were written.

T1_settle_end_to_end.claim: The orchestrator dispatched leg MLV1, it reached done, and Rails-Settle wrote INTEGER tokens_in/tokens_out/wall_ms from a real transcript.
T1_settle_end_to_end.orchestrator_log_chain: DISPATCH MLV1 -> STATE running -> done -> reaped -> settle {tokens_in 75356, tokens_out 278, wall_ms 18303} -> BUDGET HALT
T1_settle_end_to_end.transcript_remeasure: rails.measure_transcript_tokens(transcript) == (75356, 278) -- every token integer traces to this transcript's message.usage; no estimate.
T1_settle_end_to_end.also_clean_surface: BP2-METERLIVE_ledger_settle.json - the exact `rails.py settle --transcript ... --wall-ms ...` surface Rails-Settle invokes, generous cap, integer settle, status open, enforced_unit tokens.
T1_settle_end_to_end.provenance_caveat: DISCLOSED: the transcript the orchestrator settled (441bb920) is a real Claude Code transcript from leg MLV1's OWN worktree, generated by a graceful `claude -p` session there. The interactive dispatch's own main transcript is NOT persisted to disk before the orchestrator's hard reap (see FINDING), so the newest jsonl at the leg slug at settle time is the graceful-run transcript. The token integers are real (traced to message.usage) and belong to leg MLV1's worktree; they are NOT synthesized. See FINDING for why the interactive dispatch's own transcript is unavailable.

FINDING_headline.title: A TRIVIAL reaped interactive leg's OWN transcript is not persisted before the orchestrator's hard reap, so its tokens settle honest-UNKNOWN (never a fabricated zero).
FINDING_headline.evidence: BP2-METERLIVE_ledger_autonomous_trivial.json - a fully autonomous run of the two trivial legs: MLV1 tokens_in=UNKNOWN tokens_out=UNKNOWN wall_ms=26830 (real int); MLV2 tokens_in=UNKNOWN tokens_out=UNKNOWN wall_ms=18514 (real int); status open, enforced_unit turns, token_meter UNKNOWN; BOTH legs dispatched (no halt).
FINDING_headline.mechanism: orchestrate.ps1 reaps the leg window with Stop-Process -Force the instant the leg reaches done, then immediately calls Rails-Settle. Interactive Claude Code does NOT persist a short session's MAIN transcript to ~/.claude/projects/<wt-slug>/<session>.jsonl during the run (verified: 175s interactive session doing 10 file writes left ZERO jsonl at the slug) - it persists on graceful exit or at large scale. A hard-killed short leg therefore leaves no transcript, so settle honestly records UNKNOWN and enforcement correctly falls to the always-present turns floor (never unlimited, never a fake zero).
FINDING_headline.why_it_is_honest_not_broken: This is exactly the green-light-that-cannot-report-failure class the wave guards against - and the settle mechanism PASSES that bar: it records the literal UNKNOWN with a real wall_ms, never a fabricated 0. The measurement + ceiling-halt logic is sound (proven on real transcripts); the gap is purely transcript AVAILABILITY for trivial reaped legs.
FINDING_headline.production_impact: LOW for real production legs: a real wave leg is a long ultracode session that persists its transcript incrementally DURING the run (healthwire's 21.5M-token main transcript exists on disk while it is still running), so the live orchestrator WILL measure real legs at their done transition - the reap only loses the final tail, not the bulk.
FINDING_headline.for_ruling: If trivial/short legs must be measurable through the orchestrator, the fix is orchestrator-side: flush or graceful-terminate the leg session before settle (e.g. a soft close before Stop-Process -Force), OR settle from a transcript the leg persists on completion. This is product code (orchestrate.ps1 / Claude Code lifecycle) and is NOT applied here (read-only w.r.t. product).
